briefing.opening: Good morning/afternoon, everyone. I will now begin the climate briefing for September 16, 2026.

sections.title: 🔴 Deepening Climate Crisis and Key Warnings
sections.content: According to a major report released today, the Earth has already recorded its hottest August on record in 2026, with temperatures rising by 1.65℃ [12]. More concerning is a study indicating that 'natural greenhouse gases' released from permafrost could amplify global warming by up to 30% [7]. Despite this severity, warnings have emerged from the United States that claims of 'climate change being a hoax' are causing a 'reversal' in climate policy, potentially delaying carbon reduction targets by 10 years [3]. Meanwhile, lessons from last summer emphasized the imperative to 'actively respond to the climate crisis!' [10], and globally, news has been reported that climate change poses new threats to grape cultivation [168], labor productivity [169], and artificial landscapes and apple orchards in specific regions such as the UK and the US [174, 175].

sections.title: 🇰🇷 Domestic Climate Change Response Efforts and Strategies
sections.content: Domestically, the 'International Climate Industry Expo,' discussing climate change response measures, commenced today at BEXCO for a three-day run, with various companies presenting carbon-neutral blueprints utilizing AI and high-efficiency technologies [1, 71, 78, 80, 82]. Furthermore, the Climate Change Foundation and Seoul National University held a 'Greenhouse Gas Data Utilization Forum,' emphasizing the need for granular emissions data [2, 20], and initiatives included establishing a cooperation framework for improving agricultural and rural water environments, as well as a field briefing on new rice varieties developed to cope with climate change [5, 8]. The Cheongju Regional Meteorological Administration published a climate change analysis report for the Chungbuk region over the past 53 years, outlining regional climate trends [9]. However, at a National Assembly Climate Change Forum seminar, an analysis was presented suggesting that Korea's bilateral cooperation on climate change is less flexible than that of Japan, Switzerland, and Singapore, indicating a need for improvement [4].

sections.title: 🌱 Technologies and Policies for Achieving Carbon Neutrality Goals
sections.content: Various efforts are underway across the country to achieve carbon neutrality goals. The '2026 Carbon Neutrality EXPO' opened in Busan, bringing together carbon-neutral technologies and solutions for industrial sites [51, 57], and KTC and KTL showcased high-precision Greenhouse Gas Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (GHG-MRV) and ICT-based refrigerant management technologies [33, 34, 45, 52, 93]. In Jeju Island, a Green Hydrogen and Distributed Energy Forum commenced to achieve the 2035 carbon neutrality target, and the distribution of heat pumps began in cooperation with Samsung Electronics [32, 37, 39, 89]. Furthermore, Seogwipo City newly designated four carbon-neutral leading villages, expanding community-based carbon neutrality practices [50, 62, 64, 65, 73, 74, 85], and a service allowing carbon neutrality points to be exchanged for local currency is scheduled to launch in October [47, 54].

sections.title: 🌍 Accelerating Renewable Energy Transition and Current Challenges
sections.content: The renewable energy supply system has undergone a complete overhaul after 15 years, with institutional changes for energy transition, such as the Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) transitioning to a competitive bidding market [16, 94, 158, 165]. Naver made a significant investment by signing an MOU with Green Energy for a 216MW solar power supply collaboration to secure renewable energy for its data centers [96, 103, 110, 117, 121, 129, 133]. Hyundai Motor Group also presented the future of hydrogen mobility in Jeju, emphasizing its connection with renewable energy [97, 115, 119], and SK Innovation unveiled an integrated energy solution combining renewable energy, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Small Modular Reactors (SMRs), and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) to target the AI data center power market [98, 157, 160, 161, 162]. However, concerns have been raised that domestic solar cell production is virtually zero, leading to Chinese products dominating the market, and a strategy is needed to enhance industrial competitiveness through 'incentives' rather than 'localization mandates' [120, 130, 145].

sections.title: ⚠️ International Climate Change Impacts and Policy Trends
sections.content: In the international community, the tangible impacts of climate change and policy responses to them are being actively discussed. The European Union (EU) is set to launch a climate insurance scheme following a summer of extreme weather [170], and Finland is assisting the Pacific region and Indonesia in preparing for climate change and extreme weather [183]. A UN report has been credited with shifting the direction of climate change discussions [176], and the Asahi Shimbun emphasized the global sentiment that the world cannot abandon the climate change targets of the Paris Agreement [177]. Meanwhile, the UK's Climate Change Committee warned that the expansion of Heathrow Airport is incompatible with the UK's current net-zero targets, and that the aviation sector could account for 80% of the UK's total CO2 emissions by 2050 [184, 185, 188]. Additionally, a report was released indicating that nearly 60% of residents in Maharashtra, India, are concerned about climate change, demonstrating a shared global awareness of the crisis [180].

briefing.closing: We hope today's briefing serves as an opportunity to foster a deeper understanding of climate change and underscore the importance of action. This concludes the climate briefing for September 16, 2026.
